title: A common mistake: forgetting a bracket
idea: print needs an opening ( and a closing ). Leaving one off is the most common beginner slip.

exercises.explanation: It opens with ( but never closes. Every ( needs a matching ).
There's no ( after print. The text to show must sit inside ( ).

exercises.prompt: Every opening ( must have a matching closing ).
exercises.explanation: Brackets come in pairs. One open needs one close.

exercises.prompt: Which instruction is complete and correct?
exercises.explanation: Both brackets and both quotes are present and matched.

exercises.prompt: Arrange these pieces into a correct instruction.
exercises.explanation: print, then (, then the text, then ). Order: print("win").

exercises.prompt: Which of these are missing a bracket? (pick all)
exercises.explanation: The first is missing ), the second is missing (. The last two are complete.

exercises.prompt: Build a complete, correct instruction to show: yes!
exercises.explanation: All four pieces, in order, both brackets present.

exercises.prompt: print("hi") has everything it needs: print, brackets, and matching quotes.
exercises.explanation: That's a complete, correct instruction. Nothing missing.

exercises.prompt: Write a full, correct instruction to show the word: finish
exercises.explanation: print("finish") — brackets matched, quotes matched. You're spotting mistakes like a programmer now.
